ticket_text: ppadevs/ddd: replace removed EntityManager::transactional() with wrapInTransaction for Doctrine ORM 3
summary: Doctrine ORM 3 removed EntityManager::transactional(); ppadevs/ddd's DoctrineSession::executeAtomically() still calls it and would fatal on the first transaction under ORM 3. Prefer wrapInTransaction (ORM 3) with a transactional fallback (ORM 2); ship on the same v26.41.x release train as the doctrineOrmBump hotfix.

testing_packages.nimdev/ddd: v26.41.1 published 2026-09-30 (constraint relaxed; DoctrineSession fix still missing)

tags_planned.ppadevs/ddd: v26.41.x (one production tag carrying constraint bump + this fix; owner decides the final number)
